svg.title: Durante2026 processed source composites and three distinct source clocks
svg.desc: Two full native-grid surface geostrophic-speed composites with direction-only arrows and all248unjoined source coordinate means each. Supplied coordinate means extend into the Caribbean and are not a complete Loop Current axis. Three separate source clocks preserve11902extended-calendar entries and4111entries each for tid and tisp, including a missing tisp timestamp at zero-based OSW position3462, MATLAB index3463. No clock filling, route length, width, current footprint or annual extrema are inferred. Exact plot inputs and masks are in loop-durante-2026-source-view.json.
